wireContract: Combines the community core reads and song playback grants carried by 0.68.5 with the HNS root-import lifecycle projection first cut in 0.68.4: session responses optionally project the lifecycle block (phase, bounded pending reason, deadline with kind, server time, observation summary, next_check_at with retry hint, permitted actions), and publish plans optionally carry encoded_resource_sha256, the HSD wire-encoding digest distinct from the plan-document hash. Older shapes remain valid.
